mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CODEF_CONNECTION (user_id, provider, connected_id, registered_institution_keys) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{connectedId}, #{registeredInstitutionKeys})

INSERT INTO CODEF_CONNECTION (user_id, provider, connected_id, registered_institution_keys) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{connectedId}, #{registeredInstitutionKeys}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE codef_connection_id = codef_connection_id

INSERT INTO CODEF_CONNECTION (user_id, provider, connected_id, registered_institution_keys) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{connectedId}, #{registeredInstitutionKeys}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE connected_id = #{connectedId}, registered_institution_keys = #{registeredInstitutionKeys}
mapper.select: SELECT codef_connection_id AS id, user_id AS userId, provider, connected_id AS connectedId, registered_institution_keys AS registeredInstitutionKeys, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM CODEF_CONNECTION WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
